one_line: A seasoned Arabian horse merchant plying the medieval sea route between Hormuz, Arabian ports and the Indian coasts.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, lean but sturdy build, used to long sea voyages and caravan travel.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown complexion, neatly trimmed black beard with a few silver strands at the chin, straight nose, dark sharp eyes with slightly heavy lids, faint sun-lines at the corners, default expression a calm, calculating half-smile that can turn serious in negotiations.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied back in a low knot, mostly hidden under a white cotton turban wrapped in a simple Arabian style with one loose tail at the back, a thin brown leather headband visible at the base to keep it secure.
appearance.costume: Long-sleeved knee-length cotton tunic (qamis) in soft sand-beige with narrow side slits and a simple round neck, worn over loose off-white cotton trousers; a dark indigo-blue sleeveless woollen overcoat (without buttons) with side vents and subtle vertical weave lines, belted at the waist with a broad dark-brown leather belt holding small pouches; a light, striped shawl in muted cream and pale brown draped over one shoulder for warmth; feet in sturdy brown leather sandals with thick straps, ankles wrapped with simple cloth bands; minimal jewellery limited to a small silver signet ring and plain wooden prayer beads looped around his left wrist to keep the design grounded and mercantile rather than aristocratic.
appearance.signature: A sturdy rolled-up leather horse ledger case strapped to his belt, from which he often holds a slightly worn wooden-handled horse whip with braided leather lash, symbolising his trade in war horses rather than personal violence.

ref_desc: Farid al-Hindi is a lean, early-forties Arabian horse merchant with a medium-brown oval face, trimmed black beard, white cotton turban, sand-beige tunic, off-white trousers, indigo-blue sleeveless overcoat, brown belt, sandals, and a leather horse ledger case with a wooden-handled braided whip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Farid al-Hindi, a medieval Arabian horse merchant: a lean, early-forties man with a medium-brown oval face, dark sharp eyes, and a neatly trimmed black beard with a few silver strands, wearing a white cotton turban over black hair tied in a low knot. Show him in a long-sleeved sand-beige knee-length cotton tunic over loose off-white trousers, layered with a dark indigo-blue sleeveless woollen overcoat with subtle vertical weave texture, belted at the waist with a wide dark-brown leather belt holding small pouches. Add a light cream-and-pale-brown striped shawl draped over one shoulder, sturdy brown leather sandals with cloth-wrapped ankles, a small silver signet ring and wooden prayer beads on his wrist. His signature prop is a rolled leather horse ledger case strapped to his belt, from which he holds a slightly worn wooden-handled braided leather horse whip, all in a restrained palette of sand beige, off-white, indigo blue, dark brown and muted cream; show him from multiple angles to clearly display face, hair, clothing and the ledger-and-whip prop.
